KOM Sprint (HC) Col du Tourmalet - Souvenir Jacque

story: Campenaerts attacked immediately after the start, with Pedersen joining him while Artz briefly followed before dropping back after warnings about his riding position. The break was reeled in soon after the intermediate sprint. Pogačar launched his decisive attack on the Tourmalet with 43 kilometres remaining, won solo, took the yellow jersey and opened a significant lead in the general classification.
